# Eldritch Fable repository instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [PROJECT_STATE.md](../PROJECT_STATE.md) and
[the shared handoff](../docs/workspace/HANDOFF.md) before making changes.
The maintained application is `standalone/`; `recovery/` is historical.

For business identity, payment onboarding or legal-copy tasks, read
[the business evidence notes](../docs/BUSINESS_IDENTITY.md) and
[the source-safe profile](../standalone/src/config/business-profile.json).
The supplied LLC Articles are marked DRAFT. Accepted formation, corporate tax
elections and sales-tax registrations are not established by those documents.

Use the owner's private business packet through an authorized private mount for
the EIN, original PDFs and address. Never commit those details, expose them in a
browser bundle or print them in logs, issues or PRs. Do not guess missing facts.
Preserve existing work and follow the repository's verification/deployment rules.
